description: Marking your first function does not produce a wall of errors on the standard library: `Object.keys` and `s.trim()` are green with no bridges, and `JSON.parse` still needs one — a real throwing entry earning its place beside them.

diagnostics.message: Call to `JSON.parse` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is colored `throwing` by the shipped standard-library baseline, so calling it can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; or, if it cannot throw, report it against the shipped standard-library baseline at https://github.com/no-throw/no-throw/issues — the other three carriers are keyed by npm package name, and no key in that grammar reaches a `lib.*.d.ts` member.
